disclaimer: Deterministic design pre-check only. It is not a DBIM, GIGW, or Government of India certification.

rules.title: Approved local DBIM package
rules.requirement: Enable Gov generation only after the local framework, component catalogue, asset catalogue and reuse review are complete.

rules.title: No unapproved external design dependency
rules.requirement: Do not use Tailwind, Font Awesome, Picsum, or arbitrary external design CDNs in DBIM output.

rules.title: HTML5 document type
rules.requirement: Use a valid HTML5 document declaration.

rules.title: Document language declared
rules.requirement: Declare the primary page language; verify multilingual content manually.

rules.title: Unique page title
rules.requirement: Provide a meaningful document title.

rules.title: Responsive viewport
rules.requirement: Configure the page for responsive rendering.

rules.title: Local DBIM stylesheet
rules.requirement: Reference the verified local DBIM compiled stylesheet.

rules.title: Local DBIM behaviour bundle
rules.requirement: Reference the verified local DBIM behaviour bundle where interactive components need it.

rules.title: Heading hierarchy
rules.requirement: Use a logical heading hierarchy without skipped levels.

rules.title: Alternative text
rules.requirement: Supply suitable alternative text for informative images; assess decorative images manually.

rules.title: Secure references
rules.requirement: Avoid insecure HTTP references in production pages.

rules.title: Form labels
rules.requirement: Associate form controls with visible or programmatic labels.

rules.title: Accessible button name
rules.requirement: Give each button an accessible name.

rules.title: Approved component reference
rules.requirement: Use only catalogue components that have passed local reuse review.

rules.title: Component traceability
rules.requirement: Mark each declared DBIM component in output so it can be audited.

rules.title: Approved controlled fallback
rules.requirement: When no approved DBIM component fits, use only an approved internal semantic fallback and identify it as a fallback.

rules.title: Fallback traceability
rules.requirement: Mark each declared controlled fallback in HTML for audit and human review.

rules.title: Verified ministry or department branding
rules.requirement: Use only user-provided or verified official branding. Otherwise use the neutral approved placeholder; never use the State Emblem as a generic placeholder.

rules.title: Approved visual asset
rules.requirement: Use only locally packaged, attributed, approved DBIM visual assets after reuse review.

rules.title: Keyboard operation
rules.requirement: Verify that navigation and interactive controls can be operated by keyboard.

rules.title: Visible keyboard focus
rules.requirement: Verify a visible focus indicator across interactive elements.

rules.title: Privacy and consent
rules.requirement: Review privacy, policy, consent and data-collection requirements for the actual deployment.

rules.title: Content ownership and lifecycle
rules.requirement: Review owner, update date, archival and content-maintenance responsibilities.
